title: Adobe Creative Cloud for Enterprise License Management (Admin Console)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (Adobe entitlement/seat management via Adobe Admin Console; Adobe-specific internals deferred to Adobe documentation).
Non-Microsoft vendor product; Adobe Admin Console specifics are deferred to Adobe's official docs (don't invent).
hook: Bring Adobe Creative Cloud for Enterprise licensing under control
problem: Adobe Creative Cloud for Enterprise is expensive and easy to mismanage: named-user seats assigned and forgotten, products over-provisioned, and reassignments handled ad hoc. This solution gives you a repeatable way to manage Adobe Creative Cloud for Enterprise licensing in the Adobe Admin Console — clean user and product-profile assignment, usage-based right-sizing and reclamation, and a process that keeps Adobe spend matched to real need.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Adobe Creative Cloud for Enterprise licensing model (named-user, product profiles, identity types), the Admin Console assignment model, and the right-sizing/reclamation cycle.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Adobe Admin Console access, identity/SSO setup, product profiles, usage data, an entitlement record) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing. Adobe-specific configuration is deferred to Adobe's documentation.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: confirm identity and product profiles, inventory assigned seats and usage, identify unused/over-provisioned seats, reclaim and reassign, set a recurring review, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — assignment/usage discovery helper, seat-utilization validation, an Adobe seat and cost report, safe remediation (flag reclaim candidates), and a review-scope group builder. (Adobe data via the Adobe User Management API where available; otherwise Admin Console export.)
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to manage Adobe Creative Cloud for Enterprise licensing in the Adobe Admin Console — clean assignment, usage-based right-sizing and reclamation, and a process that keeps Adobe spend matched to need. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
